chunks: Yunus, from Ibn Muskan, from Abu Baseer who said:
I asked Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) about the adulterer when he commits adultery, should he be exiled? He said: 'Yes, from the city in which he was whipped to another.'

key_terms.الزَّانِي: The adulterer, one who commits zina

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling on exiling an adulterer after he receives his lashes?
ai.summary: In this hadith from *Al-Kafi*, Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) clarifies the ruling of *nafi* (exile) for the adulterer, specifying that the punishment involves banishment from the locality where the *jild* (lashes) were administered to another place. This ruling underscores the jurisprudential principle that exile serves as a supplementary penalty to deter public immorality and remove the offender from their immediate social environment, a view widely accepted in Shia fiqh.
